label: 動感銅管放克浩室 — 純器樂無主唱版 (124 BPM Brass & Slap-Bass Funky House)
prompt:
### Global Metadata
Upbeat, high-energy 90s Funky House and Nu-Disco instrumental groove in E Dorian at 124 BPM with a strong, driving four-on-the-floor beat. Create a lively, danceable, feel-good instrumental track of approximately three minutes for an indoor cycling rhythm ride. The groove must feel bouncy, punchy, and infectious from the very first bar, with crisp transients, tight low-end punch, and vibrant mid-range funk energy.

### Vocal Details
Purely instrumental composition throughout the entire piece. All lead melodies, rhythmic motifs, and harmonic layers are performed exclusively by a thumb-slapped and popped electric funk bassline, crisp Nile-style wah-wah rhythm guitar chops, punchy multi-horn brass section stabs (trumpet, tenor sax, and trombone hits), lush 70s disco string swells, a heavy 909 four-on-the-floor kick drum, snappy handclaps on beats two and four, and sizzling off-beat open hi-hats.

### Arrangement
Intro: launch immediately into a punchy 124 BPM four-on-the-floor kick drum, off-beat hi-hats, rhythmic wah-wah guitar scratches, and a bouncy slap-bass groove. Main Groove Theme A: lock into a tight, syncopated slap-bass riff trading playful rhythmic phrases with funky muted electric guitar chords. First Brass and String Hook: unleash bright, explosive brass section stabs and soaring disco string swells that answer the funk bassline with celebratory dancefloor momentum. Main Groove Theme B: introduce a groovy clavinet counter-rhythm while keeping the driving kick drum and slap bass relentless. Percussion Interlude: feature an energetic conga and bongo percussion workout with filtered funk guitar loops building tension over the steady kick. Brass and Guitar Solo: showcase a dynamic brass horn and funk guitar solo over the full rhythm section. Peak Instrumental Hook: bring back the full brass horn hook and disco strings at peak energy, driving the cycling cadence forward. Outro: resolve the brass riff cleanly over the tight drum groove with a crisp, natural ending.

label: 陽光浩室鋼琴合成器舞曲 — 純器樂無主唱版 (126 BPM House Piano & Synth Boogie)
prompt:
### Global Metadata
Bright, euphoric 80s and 90s Classic Piano House and Electro-Boogie instrumental dance anthem in F Major at a fast, uplifting 126 BPM. Create a distinctly different, joyful, high-momentum instrumental composition of approximately three minutes for an upbeat cycling cruise. The rhythm is fast, sparkling, and electronic, driven by percussive house piano chords and an octave-jumping analog synth bassline.

### Vocal Details
Purely instrumental composition throughout the entire piece. All lead melodies, rhythmic motifs, and harmonic layers are performed exclusively by bright, percussive 90s Korg M1-style house piano chord stabs, a fat octave-jumping analog Moog/Juno synth boogie bassline, a catchy sparkling analog synthesizer lead melody, shimmering electric piano arpeggios, a punchy club house kick drum, crisp rimshot-claps, and continuous 16th-note disco shakers.

### Arrangement
Intro: open with bright, rhythmic house piano chord stabs, fast 16th-note shakers, and a punchy 126 BPM club kick drum joined by an octave-jumping analog synth bassline. Main Groove Theme A: introduce a catchy, bouncy analog synthesizer lead melody dancing over the driving synth boogie bass and crisp drum machine groove. First Piano and Synth Hook: elevate into a euphoric house piano anthem hook trading melodic phrases with a bright poly-synth riff. Main Groove Theme B: shift into a sparkling synthesizer arpeggio pattern and syncopated electric piano chords while maintaining the relentless 126 BPM four-on-the-floor pulse. Filter Sweep Interlude: a short, high-energy synth filter sweep and driving snare-roll riser that propels the rhythm straight into the solo without losing the beat. Piano and Synth Solo: trade bright, uplifting house piano runs and analog synthesizer phrases over the pounding beat. Peak Instrumental Hook: combine the full percussive house piano anthem chords, octave-jumping synth bass, and bright synth lead hook for maximum uplifting momentum. Outro: wrap up cleanly on the rhythmic piano and synth bass groove with a smooth final fade.
